Q. 1 عَبْهَلَ الإِبِلَ (inf. n. عَبْهَلَةٌ, TK) He left the camels to pasture by themselves, (Lth, S, O, K,) and to go to the water when they pleased: (TA:) like أَبْهَلَهَا; (S, O;) the ع being substituted for the ا. (S.) ＝
-A2- And عَبْهَلَةٌ and عِبْهَالٌ signify The act of reproving, blaming, or censuring: (K:) inf. ns. of عَبْهَلَهُ he reproved him, &c. (TK.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
